dominant_strengths: Atmospheric night-river palette with warm amber 'today' node creates genuine emotional pull and clear focal hierarchy
Concept of events floating on a wave is evocative and on-brief, with subtle layered horizon lines hinting at depth
Restrained iconography and tiny date captions keep the timeline poetic rather than dashboard-like
dominant_weaknesses: Vast empty top half wastes canvas; nodes hug the lower edge with no contextual content (agenda, details, past/future hints)
River metaphor is static — no visible flow line connecting nodes, so the 'time-river' reads as five disconnected bubbles
Label typography is uniformly small and low-contrast; date sublabels nearly vanish against the dark gradient
fix_priorities: Draw an actual flowing current/path threading the nodes so the river metaphor becomes structural, not decorative
Use the empty upper region for a focused 'Launch day' detail panel, anchoring behavioral utility
Increase label contrast and vary type weight between event title and date for clearer hierarchy
Add subtle parallax or current motion cues so 'today' feels temporally distinct from past/future nodes
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral atmosphere leads, reflective metaphor follows, but behavioral utility is thin — you can't actually do anything with the week.
rationale.intent_fit: It gestures at 'time-river' through wave imagery and a temporal node sequence, but lacks the connective flow and informational density to fully deliver the metaphor.
